svg.title: Execution contexts
svg.desc: Three execution lanes on the left, the main JS thread, the default worklet runtime and the UI worklet runtime, all pointing at a single shared native C++ heap column on the right; wrapAsync dispatches from the JS thread and resolves a Promise back.

svg.text: Handles are valid in every runtime and cost nothing to pass across one. The bytes they point at never move.
